value.rationale: This is the exact intrinsic metric 2-face area distribution of a natural infinite family of high-dimensional graphical zonotopes, beyond the ordinary f-vector. The two classes have equal side lengths/perimeters but unequal areas, and the sharp p-dependent thin-side law gives an interpretable asymptotic random-face geometry. It is not an arbitrary bounded computation; all positive p,q≥2 are classified.
